description: We would be delighted to welcome you to our apartment featuring 5 bedrooms, located just steps from the Luxembourg Gardens and the iconic cafés of Saint-Germain-des-Prés.The spaceThis superb 150 m² apartment is located on the ground floor.It consists of:Main level:- A fully equipped kitchen including a refrigerator, induction hob, toaster, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, washer-dryer, dishwasher, and more.- A beautiful, minimalist living area featuring a sofa, TV, side table, and a dining table for up to 10 people.- A first bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200) and a dressing area.- A second bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200) and a dressing area.- A third bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200) and a dressing area.- Two modern bathrooms with showers, sinks, towel warmers, and toilets.- One modern bathroom with bathtub, sink, towel warmer and toilets.Upper Floor: - A fourth bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200) and a dressing area.- A fifth bedroom for 2 guests with a queen-size bed (160x200) and a dressing area.- One modern bathroom with a shower, sink, towel warmer, and toilet. One modern bathroom with a bathtub, shower, sink, towel warmer, and toilet.- TV and high-speed Internet (WiFi).- Plenty of storage space.- Complimentary toiletries: Typology shampoo and shower gel are provided.- Bed linen and towels are included.Guest accessMetro:- Vavin (Line 4) – 3 minutes walking: direct access to Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Châtelet, and Gare du Nord- Notre-Dame-des-Champs (Line 12) – 4 minutes walking: connects to Montparnasse, Saint-Lazare, and PigalleTrain:- Gare Montparnasse – 8 minutes walking: mainline trains + metro connections (Lines 4, 6, 12, 13)Bus:- Line 58 – towards Châtelet, Luxembourg, and Vanves- Line
